_comment: Declared intent: the CI checks that MUST be in main's branch-protection required set. tools/required_checks_gate.py fails on drift in either direction (declared-but-unenforced = a gate that never blocks; enforced-but-undeclared = a gate nobody reviewed). Edit this file only alongside an intentional branch-protection change.

notes.ci (0..3): The 4-way python shard matrix from .github/workflows/ci.yml. All four shards gate; a shard missing here would let its slice of the suite fail silently.
notes.windows: The Windows aggregator job. Never rename it -- the required-check context is matched by name, so a rename silently drops the gate.
